name: Lenaia
summary: The midwinter Dionysia of the wine-press, a festival of comedy above all, when the archon basileus led the procession and the theatre belonged mostly to Athenians.
testimonia: Aristophanes, Acharnians 504–506 ("we are by ourselves at the Lenaion")
Mikalson (1975) 109–110 (the days a reconstruction around 12 Gamelion)
